conversationalSummary.text: TODAY looks like a bit of a rare one for Rey Cortiço, mainly early around 08:00, but the wind angle isn’t great and Surfline has been a little inconsistent. I’d check the Surfline cams and the MEO Beachcam before heading out—if it doesn’t look cleaner than expected, I’d just skip it rather than force the conditions. The tide is dropping and the sandbank lineup will matter, so cams are the real decider here.
